# Reified documentation

Read the trust boundary before anything else: `Schema.parse` over `Data` runs constraints, refinements, and
constructor invariants and accumulates path-aware `SchemaErrors` for untrusted input. The compiled
`Json.deserialize`/`tryDeserialize` codec is the trusted path and skips constraint metadata, enforcing only the wire
shape. Decoding an attributed record with the trusted path looks validated but is not. Choose with
`/guides/choosing-an-api.html`.

## Task router

| I want to… | Canonical page |
| --- | --- |
| Parse untrusted structured input into a model with path-aware errors | `/schema/quickstart.html` |
| Choose between parse, check, codec, and contract | `/guides/choosing-an-api.html` |
| Put a reusable value rule on a field or value | `/constraints/constraints.html` |
| Record "this passed its rule" in the type itself | `/refined/index.html` |
| Parse serialized primitive text | `/parsing/index.html` |
| Build, change, compare, and test structured data | `/data/index.html` |
| Compose, recover, or accumulate over `Result` | `/result-handling/llms.txt` |
| Serialize and deserialize JSON for producers I trust | `/schema/json-codecs.html` |
| Export JSON Schema from a declaration | `/api/Reified.JsonSchema.html` |
| Describe a model to a form or admin UI | `/api/Reified.Inspect.html` |
| Generate a schema from record attributes at build time | `/schema/derivation/index.html` |
| Keep reading old wire versions | `/schema/versioned-contracts.html` |
| Run one declaration on .NET and Fable JavaScript | `/notes/aot-trimming-fable.html` |
| Know which package to install | `/notes/packages-and-platforms.html` |
| Map a failure type to its meaning and conversion | `/guides/error-taxonomy.html` |
| Pin down "trusted", "admission", "opaque", or "wire" | `/guides/glossary.html` |

## API disambiguation

| Operation | Input | Runs constraints | Error type | Trust the payload? |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Schema.parse` | `Data` | Yes | `SchemaErrors` | No — untrusted boundary |
| `Schema.check` | an existing `'model` | Yes | `SchemaErrors` | No — the value's history is uncertain |
| `Json.deserialize` / `Json.tryDeserialize` | JSON `string` | No — wire shape only | `JsonCodecException` / `Result<_, string>` | Yes — storage, internal service, cache |
| `Contract.parse` | `Data` | Yes — version parse, migrations, recheck | `ContractError` | No — old wire shapes must stay readable |

## Package routing

Schema uses Constraint, Parse, Data, and Refinements; each package can also be installed without Schema. Result is an
independent set of composition tools. Load only the context needed for the task:

- Schema parsing, JSON codecs, versioned contracts, and path-aware diagnostics: `/schema/llms.txt`
- Reusable value rules and structured violations: `/constraints/llms.txt`
- Invariant-carrying types: `/refined/`
- Primitive text decoding and Result composition, `result { }`, and accumulating builders: `/parsing/`,
  `/result-handling/llms.txt`
- Structured fixtures, immutable edits, comparisons, and produced-data matching, also the required input shape
  for `Schema.parse`, not only a testing convenience: `/data/llms.txt`

`Reified` is an umbrella package that installs every runtime package at once. It adds no API of its own: every
type still comes from the package documented above.

Effects, services, concurrency, and hosting are not part of Reified. They live in Axial
(https://github.com/adz/Axial).
